picks.name: Spain vs Portugal
picks.description: Two European giants face off in the World Cup Round of 16. Lunchtime kickoff — catch it at bars across Portland before USMNT tips at 5pm.

picks.name: USMNT vs Belgium
picks.description: USA vs Belgium in the World Cup Round of 16. Providence Park's free event is sold out, but venues across Portland are all showing it.

picks.name: JT Wise & Cosacchi
picks.description: Free lunchtime live music at Pioneer Courthouse Square. JT Wise Band and Cosacchi bring warm, roots-influenced sounds to the heart of downtown Portland.

picks.name: OMSI Science Pub
picks.description: Science meets nightlife at Mission Theater. OMSI's popular lecture series brings local researchers to the stage for an evening of ideas and drinks.

picks.name: Hip Hop Soulsation
picks.description: Free outdoor hip hop performance and movement workshop at Gateway Discovery Park. Open to all ages and skill levels — just show up ready to move.

picks.name: Tabor Dance
picks.description: Free outdoor social dancing at Laurelhurst Park. No partner or experience needed — a welcoming community event under the evening sky.

picks.name: South Waterfront Market
picks.description: Outdoor market with local produce, artisan food, and handmade goods along the river. Scenic Waterfront setting — a great lunchtime escape from the office.

picks.name: Music at the Park
picks.description: Free live music at Laurelhurst Park. Bring a blanket and settle in for a summer evening concert under the trees — a perfect low-key Thursday night.

picks.name: Portland Night Market
picks.description: Portland's biggest night market fills SE Alder with 200+ local vendors — food, art, vintage, and handmade goods. Free and all ages, running until 11pm.

picks.name: Movie in the Park: Elio
picks.description: Pixar's Elio screens outdoors at MLK Jr Park. A heartfelt sci-fi story about a misfit kid who becomes Earth's alien ambassador — free, bring a blanket.

picks.name: Mississippi Street Fair
picks.description: N Mississippi Ave shuts down for local vendors, live music stages, and food carts. The full energy of one of Portland's most vibrant neighborhoods, free and all ages.

picks.name: Overlook Porchfest
picks.description: Musicians play from front porches throughout the Overlook neighborhood as visitors walk house to house discovering sets. One of Portland's most charming free summer traditions.

picks.name: Tribute to Stevie Wonder
picks.description: Portland Cello Project pays tribute to Stevie Wonder at Ventura Park, part of Portland Parks' Summer Free for All. Soulful, free, and all ages.

picks.name: Overlook Yard Sale
picks.description: Community-wide yard sale throughout Overlook, with dozens of households participating at once — plus a free table for things folks just want to give away.
